fidelityRationale: Explore and meet remain two second-person objectives. Mabel népével denotes Mabel's people, matching glossary052/139, the Into The Woods synopsis and492:771-809: a mouse community with its own language, matriarch, succession and traditions. It does not restrict the encounter to biological relatives. No names, quantities, controls or disclosure timing change.
naturalnessRationale: Fedezd fel az erdőt and ismerkedj meg Mabel népével are grammatical, idiomatic Hungarian quest imperatives. The instrumental complement népével correctly follows ismerkedj meg. The comma and conjunction naturally coordinate the objectives.
rationale: Clean community repair. The full contextual reading supports népével; the original családjával unnecessarily narrowed this quest's community referent. Explicit source family statements elsewhere remain valid and unchanged.

fidelityRationale: Keress retains searching, fényforrást the required light source, az erdőben the forest, and hogy meglátogathasd the purpose and ability to visit. Mabel népét identifies the same mouse community as the adventure synopsis and firefly preparation. The quest title's discovery/light association remains available; no family-only relationship is added.
naturalnessRationale: Keress fényforrást az erdőben, hogy meglátogathasd Mabel népét is natural Hungarian objective prose. The indefinite imperative and definite subordinate verb correctly match their respective objects; népét is the appropriate possessed accusative.
rationale: Clean light-source quest repair, consistent with Fény derül rá and the unchanged community synopsis. No omitted objective, changed agency, or new condition.

fidelityRationale: Scarlett remains the first-person agent taking one strap-on to the plant and vigorously using it.170:204-211 establishes reversal from receiving penetration to stimulating the plant's receptive flower and inserting her paw; felcsatolható műpéniszt preserves the subsequent penetrative toy. Glossary152 supports this contextual sense. Inventory glossary103 still denotes its adjustable attachment harness, so a global replacement would be wrong. Manapság and alaposan megdolgozom retain habitual present and go-to-town enthusiasm. [pic=3] is exact, and214-217 continue the same plant referent and aftermath.
naturalnessRationale: The accusative műpéniszt agrees with viszek; alaposan megdolgozom idiomatically conveys vigorous action on the already identified plant. The sentence reads naturally in Scarlett's playful spoken register without adding an explanatory aside or switching the acting partner.
rationale: Clean contextual distinction between a penetrative strap-on and a harness alone. Only the necessary noun phrase changed; the preserved surrounding wording remains faithful and grammatical.
